examples.title: Merge Sort in JavaScript
examples.description: Split a list into small parts, then merge them in order. Trace merge sort and its extra buffer with complete code in six languages.

examples.title: Merge Sort in Python
examples.description: Split a list into small parts, then merge them in order. Trace merge sort and its extra buffer with complete code in six languages.
examples.code:
def merge_sort(a, buffer, left, right):
    if left >= right:
        return
    mid = left + (right - left) // 2
    merge_sort(a, buffer, left, mid)
    merge_sort(a, buffer, mid + 1, right)
    i, j, k = left, mid + 1, left
    while i <= mid and j <= right:
        if a[i] <= a[j]:
            buffer[k] = a[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            buffer[k] = a[j]
            j += 1
        k += 1
    while i <= mid:
        buffer[k] = a[i]
        i += 1
        k += 1
    while j <= right:
        buffer[k] = a[j]
        j += 1
        k += 1
    for pos in range(left, right + 1):
        a[pos] = buffer[pos]

a = [4, 2, 3, 1]
buffer = [0] * len(a)
merge_sort(a, buffer, 0, len(a) - 1)
print(*a)

examples.title: Dynamic Programming in Python
examples.description: Count stair-climbing choices by saving smaller answers. Trace a dynamic programming table and reuse its values in six languages.
examples.code:
n = 4
ways = [0] * (n + 1)
ways[0] = 1
for step in range(1, n + 1):
    ways[step] = ways[step - 1]
    if step >= 2:
        ways[step] += ways[step - 2]
print(ways[n])
